title: ‘Ramdam na namin’ — Bulacan farmers worry over Super El Niño impact
summary: Farmers in Pulilan, Bulacan are growing concerned over dwindling water supply in their rice fields as the country braces for the expected peak of the Super El Niño phenomenon in the coming months.
